integrity.reproducibility: The accompanying verify.py uses only the Python standard library and enumerates all marked coefficients over two finite fields.

scientific_limitations: The formulas count marked equations over \(\mathbb F_{3^m}\) modulo common nonzero scalar, not isomorphism classes or moduli-stack points.
The claim concerns geometric smoothness and characteristic \(3\) only. No extension to other primes is asserted.
Finite enumerations independently corroborate the algebraic proof, but are not its all-field justification.
title: Exact \(3\)-rank distribution of smooth Ciani quartics in characteristic \(3\)
